edges.target_label: SMELT: Scaling Laws for Compute-Matched MoE Looped Transformers (2026)
edges.note: The Transformer fixes depth by stacking distinct layers; SMELT revisits that choice by reusing a block, so depth is bought with computation instead of with parameters.

edges.target_label: SMELT: Scaling Laws for Compute-Matched MoE Looped Transformers (2026)
edges.note: DeepSeek-V3 established the sparse mixture-of-experts regime at scale that SMELT loops, and the separation between total and activated parameters that SMELT extends to a separation between parameters and parameter reuse.

edges.target_label: SMELT: Scaling Laws for Compute-Matched MoE Looped Transformers (2026)
edges.note: ST-MoE established stable sparse expert routing and the practice of comparing expert models at matched activated parameters; SMELT tightens the matching to FLOPs, parameters and KV cache at once so the looping gain is no longer confounded with extra compute.
